text.description_html:
KABA Simplex 9290000 Keypad Deadlatch Department of Defense (DOD) Compliant

The KABA Simplex 9290000 mechanical pushbutton keypad for 1-3/4" to 2-1/8" thick doors. 5/8" Throw Deadlatch (Auto Locking) - Unlock door with the pushbutton keypad from the outside. Ideal for locations with frequent personal turnover - no keys required - Department of Defense (DOD) Compliant. Easy to install, program and maintain.

Use on doors where self latching is required. Automatically re-locks each time the door closes. Unlock door for exterior with single access combination code while allowing free egress at all times by interior thumbturn.

Other Simplex 900 Series Models:
KABA Simplex 9020000 Keypad Deadbolt for 1-3/8" Door Thickness
KABA Simplex 9040000 Keypad Deadbolt for 1-3/4" to 2-1/8" Door Thickness
KABA Simplex 9100000 Keypad Deadbolt With Key Override
KABA Simplex 9170000 Keypad Deadlatch for 1-3/8" Door Thickness
KABA Simplex 9190000 Keypad Deadlatch for 1-3/4" Door Thickness
KABA Simplex 9380000 Keypad Deadlatch With Key Override and Latch Holdback

Features of the KABA Simplex 9290000 Deadlatch

  • Easy to maintain - no batteries to replace.
  • Durable heavy-duty construction.
  • Single access code—one easy to manage code for all users
  • Easily programmed with Allen wrench without removing lock from the door
  • Department of Defense (DOD) Compliant
  • Highly weather resistant

Specifications of KABA Simplex 9290000 Deadlatch

  • Construction: All metal cast rear housing. Force-proof clutch protected thumbturn. Brass exterior trim plate
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" to 2-1/8".
  • Installation: Rim type deadlatch surface mounted on inside of door. Through bore 1-5/8" diameter for barrel; 3/4" diameter for thumbturn. Face plate covers mounting holes.
  • Backset: 2-1/2" for inswing doors; 2-9/16" for outswing doors.
  • Latch: 5/8" throw auto locking deadlatch.
  • Strike: Includes strike plate for outswing doors and cast box strike for inswing doors.
  • Handing: Non-handed, field reversible.
  • Numeric Keypad: Vandal resistant, mechanical 5 button keypad with Roman numerals.
  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Warranty: One (1) Year.
  • KABA Simplex 900 Series Specifications (PDF)
  • KABA Simplex 900 Series Installation (PDF)

Note: A Metal Door Adaptor Strike Kit is required for installing KABA 900 series locks on Metal doors and Metal door frames.
